description: An oil-style painting of a wooden sailing ship's rail on a stormy grey sea, with rigging and a mast at the top edge. A crowd of people in 18th-century dress stands along the rail: men in dark coats and broad or tricorn hats, and women in white linen caps and dark shawls. A woman in a dark shawl and white cap sits at the centre, looking anxious, while spray breaks against the bow on the left. No visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.
